# Chibuike Ewenike

> Software engineer (backend, full-stack, AI systems and AI agents) based in Lagos, Nigeria, working remotely. 3+ years building and running production SaaS in Python (FastAPI, Django), Go and TypeScript (React, Next.js, Node.js). Also a lawyer: called to the Nigerian Bar in July 2025.

Contact: sopewenike@yahoo.com, +234 903 212 5576, https://www.linkedin.com/in/chibuike-ewenike/, https://github.com/Chibuikee

## Case studies

- [QuickPharms](https://www.bytealpha.online/projects/quickpharms): founder and lead engineer. Multi-tenant pharmacy SaaS and offline-first POS; Go + PostgreSQL row-level security, ~275 REST endpoints, React PWA, HL7 FHIR R5. Live at https://quickpharms.com
- [Eureka](https://www.bytealpha.online/projects/eureka): lead full-stack engineer. AI scholarship matching: eligibility gates, dense retrieval in Qdrant (nDCG 0.918 vs 0.844 for hybrid BM25/RRF), LLM scoring into three fit tiers; FastAPI, Celery, Stripe.
- [Green Rhino](https://www.bytealpha.online/projects/green-rhino): full-stack engineer. Trucking fleet management with live GPS tracking over SSE; Go, React PWA, Oracle Cloud.
- [Lexanalytics](https://www.bytealpha.online/projects/lexanalytics): software engineer. AI legal research, analytics and contract automation; metadata extraction, Haystack retrieval.

## Other work

DanceDeal Training Foundation (dancedeal.org), Dancerapy (dancerapy.org), Nuvoro (nuvoro.net), StalwartBlue (opticap.stalwartblue.com), BrainzCode, Growthclub (growthclub.life).
